description: Land Title Settlement Department - Lunuwila, Wennappuwa D/S Division, Puttalam District - Cad. Map No. 410004 (23/0823)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, specifically declarations of determination regarding title to specific land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed land parcel information including location details, ownership records, extent measurements, and encumbrances - all characteristic of land-related administrative matters.
